Kit summary

Rapid BlowBasic
Deals 2 stages of 120% DEF DMG each to a single enemy, with a 60% chance to steal 1 type of attribute buffs from the target. There is also a 50% chance to inflict [Stun] for 1 turn after successfully stealing a buff.
Dashing CrossActiveExclusive Lv.2
Deals 360% DEF DMG to a single enemy, with a 90% chance to reduce the target's DEF by 30% for 2 turns and a 90% chance to inflict [Feebleness I] for 2 turns.
Blast Gloves Lv.2Dashing Cross: Increases the DEF reduction to 60% and inflicts [Feebleness II] instead of [Feebleness I].
Defensive InstinctPassiveExclusive Lv.1
The ally with the highest Max HP grants [Ally Protection] to themself at the beginning of each wave. Additionally grants Ruen and this ally 30% Effect RES respectively while under the effect of [Ally Protection], and they share 42% of the DMG taken by Ruen respectively.
Blast Gloves Lv.1Ruen immediately pursues and attacks the controlled target 1 time whenever an ally successfully inflicts a control effect. Skill CD: 1 turn.
Fist BlastActiveExclusive Lv.3
Deals 200% DEF DMG to all enemies and reduces their Turn Meters by 30%, with a 35% chance to inflict [Stun] for 1 turn.
Blast Gloves Lv.3Fist Blast: Increases the Turn Meter reduction by 10% and increases self Turn Meter by 50% after casting it.
